<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

A pod template carries procedures about the pod itself and links procedures in the repo; its procedures and seed text carry what pij does not do, such as creating a run's branch and worktree or asking seats in training not to read earlier runs.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- A template brings how to run it, and what pij leaves to it, wherever it goes.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Running procedures (PRD 005 does).

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Cost: on demand only: reading a template's procedures is in-process. No loop, poll or timer.
- No permission rule changes (PRD 003); no daemon enforcement of a type's rules; no existing JSON field removed or renamed.
- Builds nice-19 through `just shared-build`, one at a time.
